messages:
Samira: Quick sync on the ACME trial — need alignment on success metrics, SE coverage, and open security questions. Thinking 6-week sprint, can we lock milestones + owners by EOD tomorrow? :calendar:
Jordan: I'm good with 6 weeks. Need clarity on expected throughput — are they planning batch ingest or real-time chat?
Kelsey: Security Qs — they asked for SOC2 details, network topology, and data retention policy. I can draft answers but need eng sign-off on VPC peering and KMS flow.
Frank: SE support: I can cover weeks 1-3 for integration and week 5 for acceptance. Out week 4 on travel. Who'll own week 2 performance tuning?
Lee: I can take perf tuning week 2. Proposal for acceptance criteria:

```text
- p95 latency < 250ms on 1k concurrent chat requests
- inference cost <= $0.015/token at 95%ile
- Eval pass rate: >= 88% on seed prompt set (top-1)
```

Is that too strict?
Jordan: Cost target looks aggressive but ok if we enable KV caching + 4-bit quantization. Ops to confirm.
Samira: Good — let's capture deliverables: integration checklist, eval prompt set, acceptance runbook, security responses. Assign owners?
Kelsey: I'll own security responses + KMS diagram. Frank -> integration checklist. Lee -> eval prompt set + acceptance runbook. Jordan -> cost/perf config + billing estimate.
PresalesBot: created ticket P-3421 and added watchers: Samira, Jordan, Frank, Kelsey, Lee
Samira: Timeline draft:
- Week 0: kickoff + infra access
- Week 1: integration
- Week 2: perf tuning + quant configs
- Week 3: full eval runs
- Week 4: pilot usage, bugfixes
- Week 5: acceptance run and docs
- Week 6: handoff to support

Can everyone confirm availability for these windows?
Frank: Confirmed for W1 and W3, W5. :thumbsup:
Lee: Confirmed W2 and W3. Suggest we add a mid-sprint checkpoint end of W2.
Jordan: I'll prepare quick cost scenarios (3 flavors: conservative/ balanced/ aggressive) by tomorrow noon.
Kelsey: Heads-up — ACME's security team may push for on-prem key management. If that happens, Private deployment could add 2 weeks. Flagging as blocker.
Samira: Noted — contingency: can we prepare a quick slide explaining tradeoffs (latency vs compliance) in <24h? Jordan + Kelsey, you two?
Jordan: Yep, will draft the cost/latency slide. Kelsey: can you add compliance notes?
Kelsey: On it. Also sending the initial SQ answers in thread tomorrow morning.
Samira: Perfect. Final ask — everyone drop a 1-line risk they see.
Frank: Risk: data mapping complexity on ACME side -> could delay integration.
Lee: Risk: eval seed set may not reflect production queries.
Jordan: Risk: third-party embeddings provider for rerank could change cost profile.
Kelsey: Risk: contractual requirement for audit logs retention > 7 years -> storage cost bump.
Samira: Thanks all — I'll synthesize and post updated runbook by EOD. If no objections, I'll schedule kickoff for next Monday 10am PST. :calendar:
